description: Controlled count-scope evaluation: paraphrases of a verified public-manuscript audit plus explicitly synthetic different-version/incomplete-input controls. These are not manuscript quotations. Expected answers and field targets are evaluation-only and excluded from model requests.

excerpts.text: Controlled paraphrase of the 21 October 2026 audit of the 31-page UEA accepted manuscript: the broader vocabulary total is 46 occurrences, including 21 case-insensitive whole-word occurrences of Left (including possessive and lowercase political uses). Body=42; bibliography=4. The disjoint listed-form groups have (body,bibliography) counts: Left / The Left=(21,0); Leftist / Leftism=(2,0); Lefty=(1,0); Liberal / Liberalism=(9,0); Progressive=(3,0); Feminist / Feminism=(3,1); SJW / Social justice warrior(s)=(1,3); Antifa=(2,0). The 21 are included in 46, not additional. Exclude anti-liberal, anti-feminist and neoliberalism from Liberal/Feminist groups. These are lexical occurrences, not actor counts.

Controlled audit-method note for the same manuscript: 4 bibliography occurrences = 3 in article titles + 1 in the journal name Feminist Media Studies (p28); Phelan 2019's article title is on p29. The 42 body occurrences include 3 in 2 participant comments and 39 in researcher prose, including 2 reporting Zhang. Researchers can report someone else's viewpoint without endorsing it. Separate selected-term audit: 90 occurrences in 23 groups = 70 body + 20 reference titles. These selections are not established as disjoint. Counts alone establish neither bias nor justification, endorsement nor distinct hostile judgments.

Synthetic different document/version B, not the UEA manuscript: a complete declared whole-word, case-insensitive audit finds 16 occurrences in its broader vocabulary, including 4 of Left; 13 body + 3 bibliography. Leftist and lefty are separate from Left. This document's speaker/endorsement coding is not supplied.

Synthetic incomplete document/version C, not the UEA manuscript: a summary reports 46 broader vocabulary occurrences. The member breakdown, body/bibliography split, matching rules and full text are absent. Its count of the exact word Left is unknown.
